versioning.patch: Compatible corrections to the supported Stable contract
versioning.major: Intentionally breaking Stable API changes require a major version and migration guidance

webFoundations.definition: A tested and packaged web design foundation with a frozen, documented Stable API subset; not a native SDK or proof of adoption by applications
releaseLimitations: The legacy root entry point is explicitly preview-compatibility and re-exports preview controllers; @goreecloud/ui/foundation provides a narrow candidate Stable web entry, with final acceptance still open
No default GoreeCloud hue or appearance mode is mandatory; each app can select its own
Native token outputs are deterministic resources, not native component SDKs
No native device or consumer app is certified by the web package

gates.requirement: Classify every currently exported entry point and root symbol; document frozen Stable API, preview API, compatibility policy and supported browser/Node matrix
Verify exact candidate 1.0.0 tarball, LICENSE, all referenced CSS/icons/types and offline installed consumer with provenance; no broken exports
Run Node tests, contracts, token and contrast checks, package verifier and Chromium smoke on the exact 1.0 release candidate commit

Record supported-browser and representative mobile/tablet/desktop visual and functional evidence, including dark/light and independent per-app hue; document unsupported engines rather than imply support
Review dependency licenses, assets, malicious or unsafe code, client-side privacy guarantees and absence of unintended network, storage and credential behavior
Verify real-state functionality and premium visual quality in the supported web scope, establish issue triage, downgrade/rollback instructions and a maintenance owner
Verify effective branch protections and required checks on main, or record an explicit founder-authorized, risk-reviewed substitute prior to Stable
Prepare audited 1.0.0 version, migration/upgrade notes, changelog, release candidate SHA, verified asset hashes and publish/tag procedure; record actual release only after it happens

advisoryNotStableBlockers: Unfinished human screen-reader and optional accessibility enhancement work under founder instructions 13.2.1; technical/legal/platform requirements still apply
Unbuilt Android, iOS, Windows, Linux and macOS native component SDKs
Unmigrated or unaudited GoreeCloud consumer applications
Later advanced web controller stability beyond the frozen 1.0 API

followOnReleases.scope: Expand and stabilize advanced web controllers, consumer setup recipes, initial independently verified web adoption pilots; never imply all consumers migrated
First independently compiled, exercised and documented native adapter (Android Compose is a candidate); ship only validated platform capability and keep other platforms explicitly unsupported
Expand supported native desktop integration to independently verified Windows WinUI and/or Linux GTK4/Qt adapters; do not claim parity from token resources
Independently validate SwiftUI iOS/macOS integration when native toolchains and device evidence exist; expand product adoption
Additional authorized consumer integrations, cross-platform consistency and targeted mature features; reprioritize based on verified dependencies

releaseRules: A release may advance only when its declared features meet their own acceptance gates; if a platform is unverified, move it to a later target rather than claim support
Stable 1.0.0 is scoped to web foundations only; native support and consumer adoption are separate deliverables
Do not publish, tag or change the package version to 1.0.0 merely because this roadmap is merged
Before any Stable release confirm the exact release revision and publish independently verifiable artifacts
